RE5 study workspace

Ten topic modules, each with a structured chapter, a flashcard deck built from the topic question bank, and a 25 question quiz drawn fresh each run from a pool of 35 or more. Reference tables collect every deadline, threshold and requirement in one place. Three mock papers — a randomised one plus the two published papers — each run 50 questions against a 2 hour clock and the 66% pass mark.

Progress is saved on this device. Flashcard review marks, needs-review flags, best quiz scores, attempt dates, your highlights, your topic notes and your theme choice persist when you close and reopen the page.

50 questions, 2 hours, 66% to pass

Every paper runs 50 questions with the option lists shuffled. There is no feedback of any kind until you submit. The clock starts the moment you begin and the paper submits itself when it runs out. After submission you get a total against the 66% threshold and a per topic breakdown showing exactly where marks were lost, with the full explanation for every question.
